subject: a gate for the defect I keep finding by accident
the_pattern: Twice on 2026-08-04 a checker read a NARROWER source than the thing it checked, and both times I found it by luck. bucket_counts[group][key] audited nothing while reporting success; the dedup paths read "from book" after the catalogue gained a second source. Same shape as the wrong-key class: the query SUCCEEDS, so nothing that only watches for errors can see it.
built: scripts/audit-source-coverage.mjs, wired into npm run verify --strict
the_rule: when a table has a declared sibling covering the same concept from another source, a query naming one must name the other or carry an explicit waiver

my_first_version_failed_its_own_test.what_happened: reintroduced the real bug on a scratch copy; the gate reported 0 findings, exit 0
my_first_version_failed_its_own_test.cause: it used text.includes(secondary) across the WHOLE FILE, so the comment "// UNION book_external ..." satisfied it while the SQL below still read `from book` alone
my_first_version_failed_its_own_test.the_irony: a comment ABOUT the fix convinced the gate the fix was present

then_it_cried_wolf_about_itself.what_happened: verify exit 6 on a clean tree
then_it_cried_wolf_about_itself.cause: `reads` tested raw text while `secondary` tested stripped code — so prose in gate-selftest.sh reading "still read `from book` alone" registered as a real query
then_it_cried_wolf_about_itself.fix: strip once, test everything against the stripped result
then_it_cried_wolf_about_itself.why_it_matters: a gate that cries wolf about its own documentation gets muted, and a muted gate is a deleted gate

proven_both_directions.fires_on_the_bug: reverted ia-title-dedup.mjs to book-only on a scratch copy -> exit 6, names the file and the missing table
proven_both_directions.cannot_silently_rot: asserts the sibling tables exist in the live catalogue — if the rule names a table that is gone it reports THAT rather than reporting health
